powerhouseKids.title: Powerhouse Kids
powerhouseKids.description: A space for children to draw closer to God, learn, and grow in faith through experiences prepared for each stage of their development.
powerhouseKids.details: Powerhouse Kids accompanies children with age-appropriate activities and experiences, helping them learn, develop their relationship with God, and grow in an environment prepared for them.

cuna.title: Nursery
cuna.description: A space to draw closer to God through activities appropriate for early childhood, in an environment prepared for learning and development.

parvulos.title: Toddlers
parvulos.description: A stage to learn principles and values based on God's Word through activities and experiences appropriate for their age.

powerhouseKids.title: Powerhouse Kids
powerhouseKids.description: A space that accompanies their growth, strengthens their relationship with God, and helps them apply the Word in their daily life.

gen180.title: GEN180
gen180.description: A space for middle and high school students aged 12 to 17, created to accompany them in their growth and spiritual formation during a key stage of their lives.
gen180.details: GEN180 accompanies students aged 12 to 17 through a space for spiritual growth and formation, helping them strengthen their faith as they navigate this stage.

focus.title: FOCUS
focus.description: A community for young adults aged 17 to 24 who have finished high school and are navigating university studies or personal growth, seeking to deepen their relationship with God.
focus.details: FOCUS accompanies young adults aged 17 to 24 in their current challenges, offering a space to grow, develop a deep relationship with God, and move forward with clarity during this stage.

relevant.title: RELEVANT
relevant.description: A space for young adults aged 25 to 35 who seek to strengthen their relationship with God, build spiritual foundations, and grow alongside others in an important stage of life.
relevant.details: RELEVANT accompanies young adults aged 25 to 35 through relationships and spiritual foundations that help them live their faith and grow during this personal and professional stage.

about.pastorInfo: Senior pastors of PowerHouse Church in Latin America
about.bio1: Senior pastors of PowerHouse Church in Latin America. Spiritual sons of G.F. Watkins and the Genesis Team. Church leaders in Peru for 14 years, they have reached more than 500,000 people in their region.
about.bio2: In 2020, they launched Alpha Men International, a men's ministry focused on three main pillars: Identity, Affirmation, and Authority. This has driven them to train and disciple over 1,000 pastors and male leaders in Latin America.
about.bio3: They founded the international Alpha Men model and have spread it across Latin America, Europe, and South Africa.

beliefs.belief1_1_desc: It is the Word of God with authority. The sole final authority for determining all doctrinal truth. Inspired, infallible, and inerrant.
beliefs.belief1_2_desc: One God, eternally existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Equal and eternal in power and glory.
beliefs.belief1_3_desc: Jesus Christ was conceived by God the Father through the Holy Spirit in the womb of the virgin Mary; therefore, He is the Son of God.
beliefs.belief2_1_desc: God the Son, 100% God and 100% man. He lived without sin, performed miracles, and died on the cross to atone for our sins. He rose on the third day, ascended, and will return in power.
beliefs.belief2_2_desc: We are saved by grace through faith in His finished work. It is a gift from God, not the result of human effort or good works.
beliefs.belief2_3_desc: A commitment to turn away from sin to follow Christ. Essential for receiving redemption and being regenerated by the Holy Spirit.
beliefs.belief2_4_desc: A continuous process of submitting to the Word and the Spirit to develop Christ's character and live a godly life.
beliefs.belief3_1_desc: The Father's promise to empower the Church in preaching the Gospel with power throughout the earth.
beliefs.belief3_2_desc: Manifestations to build up the church and confirm the Gospel. They always operate in harmony with the Scriptures.
beliefs.belief3_3_desc: The Body of Christ and dwelling place of God, united spiritually to fulfill the Great Commission of Jesus.
beliefs.belief4_1_desc: Baptism by immersion as an ordinance and the Lord's Supper as a unique communion in memory of His sacrifice.
beliefs.belief4_2_desc: The healing of the sick is part of Jesus' work on the cross and is a sign that accompanies believers.
beliefs.belief4_3_desc: The Father's will is that we attain health, success, and spiritual, mental, and financial fullness to better serve others.
beliefs.belief5_1_desc: Physical resurrection of the saved to eternal life (Heaven) and of the unbelievers to eternal condemnation (Hell).
beliefs.belief5_2_desc: Jesus Christ will return physically and visibly a second time to establish His Kingdom on earth.
beliefs.belief5_3_desc: A covenant reserved exclusively for one man and one woman. Sexual expression is limited exclusively to marriage.
beliefs.beliefPassion: Our passion is to see families saved by Jesus.

mission.powerKidsSubtitle: An opportunity can also open a path for the future.
mission.powerKidsTitle: Power Kids: Learning, Growing and Having Fun Together
mission.powerKidsText1: Our goal is for every child to develop values, identity, and a solid foundation from an early age, through teachings, games, and activities designed especially for them.
mission.powerKidsText2: We have spaces where they can learn, have fun, and grow in a safe and loving environment, being cared for and guided by a prepared team, while you enjoy the service with peace of mind.
mission.missionCard1Short: God didn't improvise with you. You have gifts, talents, and a unique personality created with intention.
mission.missionCard1Expanded: God didn't improvise with you. You have gifts, talents, and a unique personality created with intention. We help you discover how to use all of that for something that truly matters, growing in purpose, identity, and direction for your daily life.
mission.missionCard2Short: True freedom is not doing whatever you want, but living without emotional chains...
mission.missionCard2Expanded: True freedom is not doing whatever you want, but living without emotional, mental, and spiritual chains. Here you will learn to let go of the past, heal wounds, and walk with a firm and secure identity.
mission.missionCard3Short: You were not created by accident. There is a specific purpose designed for your life...
mission.missionCard3Expanded: You were not created by accident. There is a specific purpose designed for your life. Here we help you identify your gifts, develop your leadership, and walk with clarity toward what you were truly called for.
mission.missionCard4Short: We were not only called to grow personally, but to impact the world around us...
mission.missionCard4Expanded: We were not only called to grow personally, but to impact the world around us. Here you will discover how to serve, lead, and make a real difference in your community, using your gifts to transform lives.
